$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/pricing.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (finance and sales: the payment terms library, the price lists) writes them through apps/factory-api's modules/sales/terms and modules/sales/pricelists (B-W2a-19), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies their grants reach. The floor reads nothing here (a floor session holds no price). A portal or link session reads nothing here either: a customer reads its terms and prices on its own documents; a price list PDF and the portal's catalogue priced from the customer's list are W2b (then the partner role gets select on PriceList, PriceListVersion and PriceListEntry for the lists its Party row names, which needs a party key). Master data is archived, never deleted: the office deletes only a DRAFT price list version and the entries of a DRAFT version (the …_sales_w2a_guards triggers hold it for every login). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

PaymentTerms.about: The office keeps the payment terms library (tenant-wide and per company): code, printed name, FatturaPA method, instalments, early-payment discount; archives an entry no longer used. Quotes, orders and invoices read it.

PriceList.about: The office makes price lists (base, customer, group, contract), names the list each falls back to, and archives them. Quotes and orders read them.

PriceListVersion.about: The office makes the next version of a list, edits it while DRAFT, activates it (its prices fixed, its validity set; the previous one ended the day before), and deletes a DRAFT it no longer wants.

PriceListEntry.about: The office types the price of each style (and colourway) of a DRAFT version, and removes rows of it.

PartyPriceListAssignment.about: W2b (B-W2b-03): the office gives a customer a price list from a day (the pricelists and terms modules, with Party.priceListId in the same command), ends the open one when another list is given, and reads them for the price list's Customers tab ('From'). Never deleted (the …_followups_platform_w2b_guards trigger). Office only, like the lists (the party key is named for a W2b portal that may read a customer's own).
